strings.reminder_appointment: Amahoro. Ibutsa riva ku muremesha w'amagara: mufise umubonano ku ivuriro ku wa {date}. Muze muzanye imiti yanyu. Murakoze.
strings.follow_up_after_visit: Amahoro, ni umuremesha wanyu w'amagara. Mumeze gute? Muranywa imiti yanyu imisi yose? Nimwaba mufise igipimo c'umuvuduko w'amaraso, nimunyishure, nk'akarorero 140/90.
strings.sms_check: Amahoro, ni ukubaza kw'indwi kuva ku muremesha wanyu w'amagara. Nimunyishure: umuvuduko w'amaraso nimba muwufise (nk'akarorero 140/90), nimba mwanyoye imiti, n'ingene mwiyumva.
strings.report_received: Murakoze. Umuremesha wanyu w'amagara yakiriye ubutumwa bwanyu.
strings.danger_signs_seek_care: Ni ngombwa: nimubona mu maso hagoramye uruhande rumwe, ukuboko gucitse intege, ingorane zo kuvuga, umutwe ubabaza cane giturumbuka canke kutabona, nimuje ku ivuriro ubu nyene kandi muhamagare umuremesha w'amagara.
